method: Actual complete source plans, five architect elevation panels and completed exterior photographs inspected before authoring; original model then cross-checked through actual final-mesh plan projections, sections and rendered elevations. No automatic dimensional extraction or exact scale claimed.

features.interpretation_and_limits: Independent complete administration and visitor footprints; not mirrored canopies. Outer curves and asymmetry are normalized, not surveyed.
Long pointed inland descent; main planted field, paved band, inward finger and long recessed diagonal return. Surface heights and small steps are approximations.
Rounded inland termination, large curved elbow, elongated recessed return and finger plus the inward diagonal access cut; not a second administration wing.
Genuine open clearances across the nested lakeward sequence, distinct closed supports and curved thickening soffits. No solid-filled canopy.
Shorter upper enclosure with two facade bands and reduced column rhythm; inland side continues as solid descending roof approach.
No full occupied second floor inferred from the 2F drawing-level roof marks. Glazing bars and inner service edges are simplified.

features.feature: Ground, water, court and retaining edge
features.interpretation_and_limits: Separate central planted court and paths; lakeward basin and curved retaining perimeter. Thin model closure, no giant uniform architectural plinth.
Muted concrete, dark blue-grey glazing, green planting, pale paving and restrained water. Colours are not calibrated true colour; night illumination and shadows are not paint.

omitted: Interiors, individual shops, current signage, tree species/placement, roads and car parking beyond the local context
Exact concrete board grain, handrails, drain slots, hardware and glazing counts
Unregistered close-up slits or blades; no arbitrary relocation of A05/A06 detail
Construction-section or certified dimensional accuracy; the raster 1:1500 mark is not a scale calibration
